final: WITH per_media AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_media) SELECT p.media_type_name, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM per_media p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg
